jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Ads
jobs.location: New York City or San Francisco
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIROPS

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the role
AirOps is building a new product line around AI Ads. As Lead Product Manager, AI Ads, you will own the product strategy and execution from early discovery through launch and growth. You will partner closely with the Head of AI Ads, who will bring domain expertise and channel experience. You will turn those inputs and direct customer insights into a focused roadmap and a product that can scale.

What you'll own

 - Set the product strategy and roadmap for AirOps’ AI Ads product.

 - Work directly with customers to understand their problems and how they make decisions.

 - Take ideas from discovery through launch, using prototypes and early releases to learn quickly.

 - Define how success will be measured and use customer behavior, product data, and commercial results to guide decisions.

 - Lead cross-functional execution and make clear calls on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs.



What you'll bring

 - 6+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a zero-to-one product or major new product area.

 - Direct experience in growth, digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology, measurement, or a related field.

 - A record of turning unclear customer problems into products that people use and pay for.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort making decisions from incomplete data.

 - Experience working directly with senior customers and translating what you learn into product priorities.

 - The ability to work closely with engineers and designers from early discovery through launch.

 - A hands-on approach to prototyping and modern AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar products.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong judgment, and low ego.



Nice to haves

 - Experience as a founding PM, founder, or early product hire.

 - Familiarity with AI search, AEO, or the relationship between paid and organic growth.


OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor


BENEFITS

 - Equity in a fast-growing startup

 - Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

 - Flexible time off policy

 - Parental Leave 

 - A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!

jobs.description:
ABOUT AIROPS

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're scaling AirOps into a full-stack AI Search offering for brands, and we need someone to own the build from the inside.

As the Lead Product Manager for New Verticals, you are effectively a founder-in-residence with the scale, capital, and speed of AirOps behind you. Your mandate is pure exploration and validation: identify untapped marketing and acquisition channels, run aggressive quant-heavy experiments, build out robust reporting foundations, and formulate clear hypotheses on where AirOps should make multi-million dollar product investments next.

You won't just be managing a roadmap; you'll be navigating total ambiguity, diving into SQL and funnel analysis, co-building with top customers, and transforming early performance signals into AirOps’ next core product lines. If you thrive on blank space, hyper-growth pace, and pure 0-to-1 ownership, this is your playground.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - 0-to-1 Channel & Product Incubation: Uncover, size, and test brand-new channels of business to expand AirOps into a complete growth marketing ecosystem.

 - Data-Driven Experimentation: Formulate crisp hypotheses and run rapid, quantitative tests to evaluate activation, adoption, and expansion potential before committing heavy engineering resources.

 - Measurement & Data Foundations: Build the core analytics foundation (funnel tracking, success metrics, leading indicators, custom dashboards) to rigorously prove or disprove channel viability.

 - Investment Hypotheses & Playbooks: Turn validated experiments into repeatable GTM playbooks, pricing models, and strategic business cases that guide company-wide resource allocation.

 - Customer Co-Building: Partner directly with forward-thinking marketing and growth leaders to translate ambiguous edge-case feedback into scalable product bets.
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - The Founder Archetype: You’ve founded a company, led a product at an early-stage startup, or spearheaded 0-to-1 growth bets inside a hyper-growth company.

 - Strong Quantitative & Data Background: Deep experience with data-heavy products and analytics frameworks. You don't just consume dashboards - you build them, write your own SQL, analyze complex funnels, and make confident calls with incomplete data.

 - Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: High-velocity instinct for testing. You know how to build low-fidelity MVPs and track early signals to validate demand before over-engineering a solution.

 - Relentless Product Prioritization: Exceptional product instincts that balance customer empathy with brutal prioritization. Saying "no" to low-leverage ideas to focus entirely on high-potential growth vectors.

 - Executive Presence & Co-Building Skill: High bandwidth to command the room with executive buyers, operate alongside technical teams, and collaborate across Growth, Data, Product, and Sales.
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building or scaling data-dense products within MarTech, AdTech, SEO, AI Search, or Content Marketing.

 - Prior history navigating rapid expansion phases ($10M → $50M+ ARR) at a venture-backed tech company.


OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor


BENEFITS

 - Equity in a fast-growing startup

 - Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

 - Flexible time off policy

 - Parental Leave 

 - A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!

jobs.location: New York City or San Francisco

ABOUT AIROPS

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.




ABOUT THE ROLE

AI search is no longer an emerging growth channel for marketing teams. It’s an established part of a modern growth playbook that nearly 90% of marketing leaders reported prioritizing in a recent survey, and yet only 23% of those leaders reported having high measurement confidence in the channel. We’re looking for a senior PMM to help us turn AI search from an important but untrackable growth program into a proven part of a marketing team’s strategy. You’ll work directly with the executive team across our product, services, and revenue orgs to help define and evangelize a definitive attribution methodology for AI search, and work directly with our biggest customers and opportunities to help them quantify the impact of this new buyer journey.



This is a highly strategic role that will get to work with some of the most forward-thinking and respected minds in the marketing and growth space both on the AirOps team and across our partner network. You’ll help elevate the AI conversation for marketers out of features, visibility, and functionality and into ROI, revenue, and outcomes. This is a rare role that gives product marketing a true seat at the table to shape the product roadmap, customer relationship, and industry conversation.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Work directly with our product and services teams to define our ROI and measurement framework for customers

 - Partner with our most strategic customers to understand how they measure marketing success, and implement a measurement framework for AI search into their current reporting process

 - Collaborate with partners and the rest of the marketing team to distribute and evangelize the measurement framework across the industry. Including creating content, moderating webinars, briefing analysts, and more

 - Partner with our sales and customer teams to help them understand marketing attribution and how AI search measurement fits in

 - Elevate the business value of AirOps across our positioning, website, and 1:1 marketing materials to prove the impact of the right AI search strategy

 - Help shape our product roadmap and future offerings to maximize the business value that AirOps provides to marketing teams




WHO YOU ARE

 - 7+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or consulting

 - Experience working with partners and selling to marketing teams preferred

 - Technical domain experience working with marketing attribution systems a plus

 - Proven experience building programs from the ground up and building marketing plans that break through the industry noise

 - Experience working with analysts and creating positioning to help create and influence a category

 - Proven experience working with enterprise customers and building enablement programs to help customer-facing teams elevate the conversations they have with buyers

 - Balance of speed and rigor. You know when to step on the gas and be the first to market, and you know when thoughtfulness and thoroughness are key to winning. And you know how to do both when needed to make things happen.




OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor


BENEFITS

 - Equity in a fast-growing startup

 - Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

 - Flexible time off policy

 - Parental Leave

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own how we bring the AirOps platform and solutions to market. You’ll lead positioning, messaging, product launches, enablement, and ongoing product communications, making it easy for customers, prospects, and customer-facing teams to understand what AirOps offers, how our products and services work together, and why they matter.

This role is a unique opportunity to apply core product marketing skills across a powerful software platform, as well as the channels, solutions, and service offerings that help enterprise customers succeed. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Data & Research, and the broader Marketing team to define the story behind new offerings, build the launch discipline required for a rapidly growing platform, and enable sellers to bring that story to market.

You’ll also help rewrite the product marketing playbook for an AI-native company. This isn’t a role for someone who wants a predictable quarterly roadmap to build a plan against. Our products, market, and customers are evolving quickly. You’ll need to operate with urgency, adapt in real time, and create clarity amid a fast cadence of launches, experiments, and emerging customer needs.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop clear positioning, messaging, value propositions, and competitive differentiation for the AirOps platform and its products, solutions, and services.

 - Partner with the Product and Services teams to design go-to-market strategy and execution for new solutions, services, and major feature launches—from positioning and audience definition through announcement and seller enablement.

 - Equip sellers to communicate the value of new and existing offerings, navigate complex enterprise buying conversations, and connect AirOps’ capabilities to customers’ strategic priorities.

 - Own product enablement for Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Services, and Partnerships.

 - Partner with Product and Solutions Architecture to run beta programs. Determine when a beta program is needed, define its goals, audience, structure, and path to launch.

 - Create a clear portfolio narrative that helps customers and sellers understand how AirOps products, solutions, channels, and services work together. Define where each offering fits within the customer journey, including the problems it solves, and the audiences and use cases it serves.

 - Partner with Thought Leadership & Research to connect product launches and capabilities to broader market trends, customer priorities, and the evolving AI search category.

 - Own product and solutions pages on the AirOps website.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally within a B2B software or platform company.

 - Proven experience marketing and selling to enterprise customers and understanding buying committees within a sales-led go-to-market motion

 - Proven experience leading cross-functional launches from strategy to execution

 - Deep experience developing positioning, messaging, value propositions, and differentiated product narratives.

 - Experience designing or running beta and early-access programs in close partnership with Product and technical customer-facing teams.

 - A strong writer and storyteller who can translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling customer value.

 - A highly collaborative partner who can bring Product, Data, Sales, Solutions Architecture, Services, and Marketing teams together around a shared go-to-market strategy.

 - Comfortable operating without a fixed roadmap or established playbook. You can create clarity as products, priorities, and the market evolve.

 - Balance of speed and rigor. You know when to step on the gas and be first to market, when thoughtfulness and thoroughness are key to winning, and how to do both when needed to make things happen.

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor
